blurb: Arcadia Lake is a man-made lake opened in 1987, providing flood control, habitat for fish and wildlife, recreational and educational opportunities, and water supply to the City of Edmond. Facilities include picnicking, camping, swimming, water skiing, boating, disc golf, and hiking/biking/equestrian trails. A fishing pier and heated, covered dock are available for year-round fishing.
